note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved only from ZInQ.Translation.MultiplicationExact (itself proved only from ZInQ.SixContactMin, ZInQ.PoleCompleteness and ZInQ.Mult.SlopeRepresentation); ZInQ.Assembly.z_ratio_tendsto proved: CloseRel, close_relation_iff and bound give Close and B as printed, and close_sound and close_complete state (8) and (9); all the stated facts are proved only from the multiplication statement M (MultiplicationExact), so the verdict is conditional on it. The accumulation and derivative lemmas are proved outright but are proof steps (helpers), and do not make the passage's claims proved.

snippet.text:
theorem z_ratio_tendsto (τ : K0 →+* ℝ) {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ (x y : K0) (h : genCurve.toAffine.Nonsingular x y), M < τ x →
      x ≠ 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧
      (∃ (x' y' : K0) (h' : genCurve.toAffine.Nonsingular x' y'),
        n • Point.some x y h = .some x' y' h' ∧ x' ≠ 0 ∧ y' ≠ 0) ∧
      |τ (zCoord (n • Point.some x y h) / zCoord (.some x y h)) - n| < η := by

evidence: CloseAt T is ValRel of entry 2 of specLib, whose multiply template's height certificate calls ndep's poleTemplate (polePoly with A+e and Az^2+eH, curves x(x-l)(x+l)), so it is not [M]'s Close polynomial; closeAt_iff/sound/complete give [M]'s semantics, (8) with bound = A0|kF(n)|^24 = H_6(S_ht)|kF(n)|^24 and (9), only under hM, and the approximation step exists_rRatio_close is ndep's. I found nothing that makes the two relations equal unconditionally.

CloseAt T is the specLib/templateLibrary relation, whose multiplication height certificate calls ndep's poleTemplate (Route K curves x(x-l)(x+l)) for every T, while [M]'s certificate calls Phi for x(x-l)(x+3l); so it is another polynomial, with [M]'s semantics only under ndep's MultiplicationExact. The description (same B = A0|kF(n)|^24, approximation only in ndep's exists_rRatio_close/z_ratio_tendsto) checks out.
